C1.worst_defect: The hero never says who VendurePOS is not for or how it differs from Shopify POS, Square or Lightspeed. Real limits a client would weigh (refund is developer-only on a live store, needs_admin chores) sit far below the fold.

C2.worst_defect: 'The till's source is MIT licensed', but self-hosting it needs an RxDB Premium licence token (RXDB_PREMIUM), and the site never says that licence is paid or what it costs. Separately, the only plugin releases are 0.1.0 (2026-10-01) and 0.2.0/0.3.0 (2026-10-06). The known ReadOrder gap in 0.2.0/0.3.0 is documented as a workaround on several pages rather than fixed, which reads as an early-stage project. Nothing on the site says who runs app.vendurepos.com or for how long.
C2.where: home.desktop.02 'Setting up the store'; Limitations 'Setting up the store'; changelog.desktop.01

C3.worst_defect: Two steps a live store needs are not numbered steps: the ReadOrder fix for the till-key role sits only under 'Optional: a device key', and the email-plugin handler swap is a callout inside step 8. A collapsed note also exposes the legacy vendurepos.vercel.app origin.

C4.worst_defect: The same caveats (missing ReadOrder, refund stays Pending until settleRefund) are repeated across six or seven pages instead of living in one place with links to it. The full plugin reference is only off-site. The troubleshooting 'Any other code' paragraph is dense.

C5.worst_defect: After the two bordered cards, the home page is eight plain text feature blocks with a single product screenshot, so it looks thinner than competitor landing pages. The 404 page is mostly empty below its buttons.

C6.worst_defect: The phone 'On this page' bar already names the first section while the reader is still at the page title. The phone hero screenshot cuts the category chips mid-word ('Gif').

C7.worst_defect: The 404 page carries no JSON-LD, and Lighthouse flags 53 KiB of unused JS on /. Otherwise strong: all routes 200, llms.txt/llms-full.txt, sitemap, search API, perf 97-98.

overall_worst.defect: The site says the till's source is MIT licensed, but self-hosting needs an RxDB Premium licence token that the site never says is paid. That undercuts the open-source claim for anyone weighing it against Shopify POS or Square. It is compounded by no plugin release since 2026-10-06, with a known ReadOrder bug left as a documented workaround.
overall_worst.where: home.desktop.02 'Setting up the store'; Limitations 'Setting up the store'
overall_worst.fix: State that RxDB Premium is a paid commercial licence, link its pricing, and say plainly that the hosted till at app.vendurepos.com avoids it. Say who runs app.vendurepos.com, that it is free, and how long that is promised for. Ship a plugin patch that adds ReadOrder to the till-key role, or give a dated roadmap line for it.
